verdict.rationale: Perplexity's Search API docs explicitly list 'domain filtering' and 'controls for domains' as first-party capabilities, which is the core of this story. The documentation shown is only summary-level, though. missing for 10: explicit documentation of both allowlist (restrict) and denylist (exclude) modes, parameter names or usage examples, confirmation that domain filters also apply to Sonar/Agent answer endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
